title: querylog.py reredact neither replaces nor reports a fetch host that fails the public-host gate, so the note's remedy leaves check red
goal: reredact reports a fetch host or source host that the public-host gate refuses (replaced, dropped or left), so a stored entry that fails with 'fetch host is not a public host' is not passed over silently

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_store as s;e={'id':'a','fetches':[{'host':'pc01.corp','outcome':'ok'}]};sys.exit(1 if s.reredact_entry(e)[1]==[] and not s.public_host('pc01.corp') else 0)
